errors.MFA_SOCIAL_LAST_CREDENTIAL: This is the last sign-in identity linked to the account, and the account has no password on record — removing it could lock its holder out for good. Set a password for the account first, then this link can be removed.
errors.MFA_ALREADY_ENROLLED: Two-factor authentication is already set up on this account, so there is nothing left to configure. To move it to a different authenticator app, switch it off first and then set it up again.
errors.MFA_INVALID_CHALLENGE: This sign-in step is no longer valid — it has expired, or it was already finished. Sign in again to start a new one.
errors.MFA_INVALID_CODE: That code was not accepted. A code from your authenticator app is only valid for about half a minute, so wait for the next one and enter it without spaces; a recovery code can be used only once.
errors.MFA_NOT_ENABLED: Two-factor authentication is not available here, so it cannot be switched on for this account. Your administrator decides where it can be used — ask them to enable it.
errors.MFA_NO_ACTIVE_ENROLMENT: Two-factor authentication is not switched on for this account, so there are no recovery codes to reissue. Set it up first — the codes are handed to you at the end of setup.
errors.MFA_NO_PENDING_ENROLMENT: There is no setup waiting to be confirmed — it was either finished already, or started again somewhere else. Begin the setup again and scan the new QR code before entering a code.
errors.MFA_REAUTH_REQUIRED: Switching two-factor authentication off has to be confirmed by you. Enter a current code from your authenticator app, or the password for this account.
errors.MFA_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many incorrect codes were entered, so this sign-in attempt was stopped. Sign in again and use the next code straight from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
errors.MFA_WRONG_SURFACE: This sign-in was started somewhere else, so the code cannot be confirmed here. Go back to the page you were signing in on and enter it there.
